interface.ranges: All vectors use descending ranges [width-1:0]. No other ports.

semantics.ordering: a occupies bits 31:27; b 26:22; c 21:17; d 16:12; e 11:7; f 6:2; bits 1:0 are both one. w is bits 31:24, x 23:16, y 15:8, z 7:0.
semantics.timing: Pure combinational mapping; changes propagate without a clock or cycle latency, after combinational settling.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset, initialization, or state. Outputs depend on current inputs only.
semantics.transactions: No acceptance handshake or restrictions on input changes.

numeric.representation: Unsigned bit vectors; preserve each input bit exactly.
numeric.width: 30 input bits plus two explicitly sized one bits produce exactly 32 output bits.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, sign extension, rounding, overflow, saturation, or truncation.

verification.oracle: Independently pack a,b,c,d,e,f by unsigned shifts of 27,22,17,12,7,2 and OR with 32'd3; compare individual output bytes.
verification.directed: All zero, all one, alternating patterns, and walking-one and walking-zero tests over every one of the 30 input positions.
verification.random: 1000 deterministic pseudorandom 30-bit input patterns, checked after settling.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite compile and simulation timeouts.
verification.scope: Independent development tests only; no official evaluation, synthesis, or board checks.
